propositions: Changing a ticket's type silently carries forward a plan-review verdict computed under different criteria, because type is not compared in either reuse path (idempotent_reuse or verdict_reuse).

Type gates scoring in four specific code locations and is not cosmetic to the review; a plan that passes as a bug (exempt from criteria) keeps that pass when retyped to task (not exempt), resulting in a wrong verdict for the current type.
Both reuse paths gate on material_fingerprint, reviewed code SHA, and registry stamp but never compare ticket_type, even though it is available and already recorded in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.

The stored type must be read from the sidecar and compared against the current context type in both reuse functions, returning None (triggering a full re-review) when the types differ, while failing open (preserving reuse) when either stored or current type is absent or empty.
